verdict.rationale: Gram offers a catalog for discovering and importing third-party MCP servers from the official MCP Registry (gram-docs-17). It also has an in-dashboard playground that lets you pick a server, call its tools and inspect logs before connecting a real client (gram-docs-8), plus a Verify step that probes a remote endpoint's MCP initialize handshake (gram-docs-14). However, no evidence shows a pre-connection detail view of a listed server's tool list, input schemas, transport or hosting attributes; inspection appears to come mainly through test-driving the server. Missing for 10: documented per-server catalog detail showing tools and input schemas, explicit transport and hosting metadata display, independent or hands-on corroboration.
